title: Genesis 6:3 — man's days shall be 120 years
summary: Genesis 6:3 in English: the LORD says His Spirit will not strive with man forever because he is flesh, and his days will be 120 years. 'Spirit' is highlighted in gold and 'one hundred and twenty years' in green.

text.text: 3 Then the LORD said, “My Spirit shall not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; nevertheless his days shall be one hundred and twenty years.”

numbers.note: years allotted to man in Genesis 6:3

keywords: My Spirit shall not strive with man
